products.name: Epic AI (SlicerDicer, etc.)
products.note: Clinical decision support; patient data exposure; HIPAA critical; FDA SaMD considerations

profile_text.body:
Epic Systems is a healthcare software company founded in 1979, described on its own site as developing software to help people get well, stay well, and help future generations be healthier. The company's products are used by health systems including UNC Health, Riverside Health, WakeMed, Mayo Clinic, Parkview Health, and Mount Sinai Medical Center, among others.

Epic offers AI tools for clinical use under its broader product suite. Art is described as Epic's AI for clinicians, used to reduce documentation time and improve patient and family communication, with nurses at Mount Sinai Medical Center noted as the first in Florida to adopt Chart with Art for nursing documentation. Insights is an AI-generated chart summary tool intended to help clinicians review patient records more quickly. The company's site reports that clinicians at Mayo Clinic saw a 17% reduction in cognitive load, those at Riverside Health spent 23% less time reading notes, and those at Parkview Health spent 13% less time in Chart Review.

The site's held facts list Epic AI, which encompasses tools such as SlicerDicer, under the Healthcare and Life Sciences AI category, with notes flagging clinical decision support applications, patient data exposure considerations, HIPAA compliance as a critical concern, and FDA Software as a Medical Device considerations. No litigation, MCP servers, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the available data.
